description: This PHP class 'AttendanceReport' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Time module's reporting features. It handles preparing filter parameters, validation rules, report header definitions, data retrieval, and access control for attendance reports. The class interacts with request parameters, applies filters like employee ID, job title, subunit, employment status, and date range, and ensures proper permissions are enforced.

classes.name: AttendanceReport
classes.description: A class responsible for generating attendance reports, including filtering, validation, header definition, data retrieval, and access checks within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares filtering parameters based on request inputs, including employee number, job title, subunit, employment status, and date range.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Provides validation rules for request parameters to ensure data integrity and proper request structure.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Defines the structure and labels of the report columns, specifically Employee Name and Time (Hours).

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns an empty filter definition for this report.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the attendance report data based on filter parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the report, throwing a ForbiddenException if not.
